SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_projects, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = '规划中' THEN 1 END) AS planning_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = '施工中' THEN 1 END) AS under_construction_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = '已完成' THEN 1 END) AS completed_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = '已结算' THEN 1 END) AS settled_count, SUM(contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount, SUM(budget_amount) AS total_budget_amount, SUM(actual_amount) AS total_actual_amount FROM projects

SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.project_name, p.contract_amount, p.budget_amount, p.actual_amount, (p.budget_amount - p.actual_amount) AS budget_surplus, ((p.actual_amount / p.budget_amount) * 100) AS cost_overrun_rate FROM projects p
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects ( project_name, client_name, project_address, project_type, start_date, end_date, contract_amount, budget_amount, actual_amount, status, description, manager_id, manager_name, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{projectName}, #{clientName}, #{projectAddress}, #{projectType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{contractAmount}, #{budgetAmount}, #{actualAmount}, #{status}, #{description}, #{managerId}, #{managerName}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE projects SET project_name = #{projectName}, client_name = #{clientName}, project_address = #{projectAddress}, project_type = #{projectType}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, contract_amount = #{contractAmount}, budget_amount = #{budgetAmount}, actual_amount = #{actualAmount}, status = #{status}, description = #{description}, manager_id = #{managerId}, manager_name = #{managerName}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
